summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in imgdecode@1.0.1
details: Package imgdecode@1.0.1 (npm) was scanned across 4 files. No lifecycle-script execution, no remote fetch-and-execute, no credential or environment reads, no silent relay of caller data, and no obfuscated network destinations were observed in the shipped contents. No hardcoded attacker infrastructure, no browser/wallet/credential enumeration, and no persistence or backdoor mechanisms were identified.
